hook.name: ProtocolFeeHook
hook.description: A UUPS-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook that skims a configurable protocol fee (up to 1%) from the unspecified currency of every swap via afterSwap, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims redeemable via collect(). It also maintains a V3-compatible TWAP oracle per registered pool, writing pre-swap tick observations in beforeSwap. Supports both static and keeper-managed dynamic LP fees.
